reviews.title: Forced change
reviews.text: This far I like the old format better.  The only improvement I see so far is the ease of adding a note.  Other normal use items I have yet to search for, but don’t readily see the path.

reviews.title: Careful! Double charged!
reviews.text: I was double charged for the pro account

reviews.title: Shift Deletions
reviews.text:
Deleting shifts are a pain! Going into the specific set of days, then to that specific shift(yes you must repeat if you have multiple shifts the same thing for all)then to click a few more buttons to finally delete it. Takes a while if you have a lot of shifts. I don’t know about you but I don’t have that time. Please fix this. 

Thanks ahead of time and have a great rest of your day.

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: Would be better if there was an way to add a note to my time like it shows in the photos. Unfortunately once you download the app you don’t get that feature.

reviews.title: Irritating
reviews.text: Though I have found this app to be useful… and have left a 5 star review previously… it keeps sending me alerts to leave another review.

reviews.title: Confusing and unreliable
reviews.text: Completely unreliable app, and not user friendly.

reviews.title: Lost all time sheets
reviews.text: Got a new phone and when I did lost all time cards tried contacting and no reply

reviews.title: Break doesn’t work sometimes
reviews.text: Sometimes when you go to use the break function it doesn’t work and you have to clock out and clock back in to start a new time. It’s frustrating when you take breaks often.

reviews.title: Mass Delete
reviews.text: There should be an option to delete multiple shifts at a time.

reviews.title: Total hours worked inaccurate
reviews.text: Downloaded the app to help track the hours I’m working over my contracted hours. What I’m punching on the app doesn’t add up to the total the app displays. If I add it myself I am working more hours than it shows. Making it pretty useless as it’s not an easy true reflection

reviews.title: Not really free
reviews.text: Exporting the data critical must have function.  Unfortunately, that’s only available when you pay.

reviews.title: Not great…
reviews.text: There is no way to edit your shifts in the app, like if you accidentally skip a day, you can’t add it in later. It’s not really flexible at making adjustments and the menus are pretty discombobulated.

reviews.title: I was kicked out- the app stoped working mid shift to update to a pay to use feature
reviews.text:
Update comment: the app is now has a trial period and then you have to pay to use. Honestly so disappointed in greed. It was such a great app. And wish it had an option for ads instead of payment as it does not seem with the price. 

I work from home for a company that provides flexible work hours and schedules. Sometimes i overwork my contracted hours and it causes burnout. This app is free and really helps with maintaining a healthy work schedule. The one suggestion I would make if there is a notification stating “it looks like your clocked in, do you ishe to end your break or clock out” as a reminder tool. Otherwise I forget lol. But anyways such a good app

reviews.title: Scott
reviews.text: This app is currently broken, when tracking my shifts on Bi weekly starting on a Monday, it does not track the pay for the last Sunday for e.g starting Monday the 10th, today  sun 23rd the money is not calculated, I can see the shift tracked but it does not calculate the money earned
